title: Session Git Context
summary: A Claude Code hook that gives each new session the branch, the five latest commits and the changed files as starting context, with no prompt needed.
description: A fresh session knows nothing about what happened yesterday. This SessionStart hook prints a short briefing that Claude Code places in context: the branch, the five newest commit subjects and a list of files with pending changes.
With that in hand the agent can pick up where the last commit left off instead of asking you to explain. In a folder that is not a Git repository the hook stays quiet.
useWhen: Start a session on a branch someone else pushed
Let the agent see what changed recently without asking
Open Claude Code in a repo you have not touched for weeks

hook.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(d)}catch(e){}const cp=require('child_process');const g=a=>cp.execFileSync('git',a,{cwd:j.cwd||process.cwd(),encoding:'utf8',stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']}).trimEnd();try{const b=g(['branch','--show-current'])||'detached HEAD';let o='Session start. Branch: '+b+String.fromCharCode(10)+'Last commits:'+String.fromCharCode(10)+g(['log','-5','--oneline']);const c=g(['status','--short']).split(String.fromCharCode(10)).filter(Boolean);o+=String.fromCharCode(10)+(c.length?'Changed files ('+c.length+'): '+c.slice(0,15).join('; ')+(c.length>15?'; and more':''):'No changed files.');console.log(o)}catch(e){}process.exit(0)})"

example.prompt: Continue with the work from yesterday.
example.result: The session opens with the branch name, five commit lines such as 'a1b2c3d Add retry to uploader' and the files still modified, so Claude can name the unfinished task.

faq.question: Can I show more than five commits?
faq.answer: Yes. Change the number after the log flag inside the command, for example from 5 to 10.

faq.question: Does it run when I resume or clear a session?
faq.answer: SessionStart fires for startup, resume and clear alike, so the briefing is refreshed each time.

access: Runs git branch, git log and git status in the project folder
Prints text into the session; changes no files
